evidence: scripts/01_quantify.sh passes -l SR (unstranded forward = reads only in one orientation) although the libraries are poly-A unstranded; salmon reports the observed format as U (strand bias 0.50, SF/SR counts equal) and only 48.1% of the reads of a FASTQ file are quantified with -l SR versus 96.3% with the unstranded type, so about half of the reads are discarded because of their orientation.

scripts/02_merge_counts.py sums the NumReads column of quant.sf (the estimated read counts, not TPM/length-normalised abundance) over all transcripts mapped to each gene; the resulting matrix columns reproduce a requantification of the raw FASTQ files.

Every column of gene_counts_merged.tsv equals the gene-level NumReads obtained from the FASTQ file that samples.tsv lists for that column header (11 of 12 agree read-for-read with a re-run of the same library type; the RS79 column is a subset of RS79.fastq.gz, i.e. still that file).

The RS79 column contains only 14841 assigned reads while RS79.fastq.gz yields 45195 reads with the script library type (94090 reads in the file); it is reproduced exactly by quantifying the first 30897 of the 94090 reads of that file, so this column was built from part of a FASTQ file.
scripts/03_de.py builds a session column but fits DeseqDataSet with design="~condition", so the library-prep session is not part of the model.

DeseqStats is called with contrast=["condition","treated","vehicle"]; on synthetic data with a gene raised in treated this yields a positive log2FoldChange (and a lowered gene a negative one), i.e. treated relative to vehicle.

The padj written by scripts/03_de.py is the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment of the p-values over the tested genes: recomputing fdr_bh on the pvalue column of de_draft.tsv reproduces the shipped padj to within the printed precision (max deviation 2.3e-6), with only the untested gene left as NA.

Re-running scripts/03_de.py on gene_counts_merged.tsv and samples.tsv as shipped is reproducible between runs (identical output) but does not reproduce de_draft.tsv: base_mean agrees exactly while log2fc differs for 798 of 800 genes (up to 2.25) and pvalue/padj likewise. No variant of the model in the script (with or without the session term, with corrected or reversed condition labels) reproduces the draft either.
